title: Experiential Learning in Plant and Soil Science or Agricultural Ecosystem Sciences
prerequisites: Completion of a learning contract reviewed and signed by the faculty advisor and the director of undergraduate studies
attributes: Crosslisted with: PLS 399 Distance Learning Approved
repeatability: Repeatable to a maximum of 9A learning experience in plant and soil science or agricultural ecosystem sciences under the direction of a faculty member with supervision from an internship advisor and with clear relevance to a student’s program of study.
